sourceFacts.fact: Intussusception can cause obstruction, venous congestion and eventually bowel-wall ischaemia.
Rectal bleeding or redcurrant-jelly stool is a late and less common sign suggesting ischaemia.

labels: Intussusception: why bloody mucus is late
layout: Four plain paper cards arranged downward on a time staircase. Node1 a neutral stop symbol with the word Intussusception, no telescoping bowel. Node2 a stack of accumulating blue dots, no veins. Node3 a falling supply gauge, no tissue. Node4 a red drop beside a white wavy ribbon as ABSTRACT blood and mucus symbols, not a clinical stool picture. Exactly three arrows. Put a large ochre LATE tag above node4. Bottom note: Less common; do not wait for this sign. No target scan, bowel, vessels, organs or actual faecal illustration.
